room.prompt: Inside a crystal puller: a glowing crucible of white-orange melt low in the front, a thin pull rod coming down from above, cool silver light in the chamber above.

stage.where: just above the melt in the front middle
stage.near: the crucible's rim and the pull rod are drawn to its size

pull.prompt: A close view of a glowing crucible of white-orange melt in amber light with indigo shadows, a thin pull rod coming straight down from above, its tip holding a small plain silver seed crystal just above the middle of the melt

stage.where: hanging below the seed, just above the melt
stage.near: the crucible's rim is drawn to its size

lattice.prompt: A simplified diagram for an animated film: the lower third glowing orange liquid, above it an orderly schematic grid of silver atoms in neat rows continuing up from a seed at the top, a few loose atoms in the liquid moving up to join the grid at the boundary, no labels

lattice2.prompt: more loose atoms have joined and the ordered grid has grown a little further down into the liquid

hall.prompt: A tall crystal-pulling hall in amber and indigo light: a tall puller machine in the middle with its chamber opened wide and its pull cable hanging down empty in the middle of the opening, and far back on the right one small worker in a white clean-room suit

stage.where: hanging from the cable in the open chamber
stage.near: the far worker is small with distance; the chamber is a little taller than it

M_down.pose: only a face showing in a glowing pool of melt, eyes closed, calm, no body

M_up.pose: the face in the melt opening its eyes and looking straight up, brows rising

C_neck.pose: a short silver crystal just pulled up out of the melt, hanging from its top, its face forming, eyes wide, brows up

C_mid.pose: the crystal longer now, turning slowly, hanging from its top, a wondering smile

C_watch.pose: small, looking down at its own lower end with interest, hanging from its top

C_long.pose: very tall and long like a big silver ingot, held up at its top, looking down along its own long body in amazement, mouth open

C_proud.pose: the same tall silver ingot, held up at its top, a quiet proud smile
